description: A spellcaster who draws on inherent magic from a gift or bloodline.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.tldr: You can cast innate arcane spells using Charisma as your spellcasting ability.

features.name: Sorcerous Origin
features.tldr: Choose the source of your innate magical power, shaping your magical features.

features.name: Font of Magic
features.tldr: Tap into a flexible well of magic that lets you store and convert energy between sorcery points and spell slots.

features.name: Metamagic
features.tldr: Gain the ability to twist and modify your spells to suit your needs using sorcery points.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.tldr: Increase one ability score by 2, or two different scores by 1 (or select a feat).

features.name: Sorcerous Origin Feature
features.tldr: Gain a specialized feature granted by your chosen Sorcerous Origin.
